description: Create a new SeedBase project. Pass the schema (DDL or ORM code) in `schema` to create and import in one step: if the import fails, no project is left behind. Without `schema` the project is empty; then call import_schema next. The Free plan allows only one project, so prefer retrying import_schema on an existing empty project over creating another one.

format.description: Optional format hint for `schema` (sql, prisma, django, …). Auto-detected when omitted.

schema.description: Optional schema source to import right away (same formats as import_schema)

name: create_project
